decisions.decision: Initial canonical source association requires a prior audited source-registration receipt. Capture itself has no receipt; association/record publication occurs in a successor transaction and never embeds its own future receipt hash.

Freeze version conflict key, source-version identity and exact association identity separately. Same Markdown content may reuse the content/version identity; changed original-PDF or observation provenance must remain a separately immutable variant or explicit PROVENANCE_VARIANT refusal, never silent replacement or discard.

Derive one display head from the complete append-only nonforking decision chain. Registry namespace and mirror writes require explicit transaction/publication/catalog support before any applied/current claim.

Prefer one explicit v1-to-v2 boundary event to provisional, bound to the actual prior v1 head and claim snapshot. Keep one authoritative current history/head, not a second independent genesis or assessment ledger. Preserve all old v1 bytes and profile semantics.

Preserve existing entity and claim IDs when later adding arXiv/DOI identifiers. Add an explicit validated immutable alias-binding relation with contradictory alias/source refusal; do not silently establish a second paper over the same canonical source.

next_pure_slice: Exact schema/module/API/allowed paths still need freeze; no Builder or production writes authorized by this design record. Paper-record v2/compiler/publication/catalog follow actual accepted pure interfaces.
